subject: INITIALIZE statement
notes:
PB55 FOLD (2026-10-15, owner decision 2026-08-08 'THE RULE IS THE UNIT'): the transcription printed this rule's nested list(s) at column 0, so 3 sub-item(s) held rows of their own; indented at their measured printed level, they are this rule's body and their adjudications are folded here, nothing dropped.

[the rule's own record before the fold]
kb/Work/PB418.md + kb/Work/PB415.md - GR6b's SET-FORM ARM IS NO LONGER STAGED LOUD. PB418 gave 6a / 6b / 6c the rule's own selector (the InitializeQualification value Qualify returned) and measured 6a1 / 6a2 / 6a3 and the 6b MOVE form, but for a data-pointer / function-pointer / object-reference / program-pointer receiver qualifying through REPLACING it raised a named loud instead of writing a value: GR4 makes the implicit statement a SET and GR6b's sending-operand is identifier-2, so writing GR6a's predefined NULL there would have been a WRONG answer. It was unreachable because those category-names could not be spelled (kb/Work PB415's grammar row) and is reachable now, implemented as the bound action InitializeSetFrom whose emitter arm renders exactly what the EXPLICIT SET statement renders for the same operand pair - SetEmitter.EmitSetPointer's straight handle copy (14.9.39 Format 4) and OoEmitter's Format-5 cast-and-copy (14.9.39 GR9). Witnessed at 2002 for DATA-POINTER, PROGRAM-POINTER and OBJECT-REFERENCE (conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb415_initialize_replacing_set_form lines 1/1B/2/3, with lines 4 and 6 as the GR6a and not-a-receiving-operand controls) and at 2014 for FUNCTION-POINTER (conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb415_initialize_function_pointer, whose line 2 also re-pins that GR5c1a's omission of function-pointer is the PRINTED standard). 14.9.20.3 SR3 and SR4 screen the two shapes GR6b cannot honour - literal-1 (COBOL1982) and a sender of a different category (COBOL1983).

[folded GR-14.9.20.4-L2.1 = §14.9.20.4 6) a) 1.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work/PB418.md — GR6a1, the sender for a data-pointer / function-pointer / message-tag / program-pointer receiver that qualified BECAUSE OF THE VALUE PHRASE. The arm was 100% DEAD: the qualification it depends on was gated on DataItem.RawValue, and 13.18.63.3 SR9 plus 8.4.3.10.3 SR1a make RawValue always null for these categories in a conforming program, so the receiver silently kept its previous address. It is now reached through QualifiesCategorically() -- GR5c1a's own categorical test -- and ElementaryAction() emits GR4's implicit SET ... TO the predefined NULL. MEASURED on legal source (13.18.60.3 SR14 bars a USAGE POINTER below level 01 outside a STRONG type declaration, which is why the original probe was illegal): conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb418_initialize_value_categorical line 1 nulls an 01-level USAGE POINTER after SET P1 TO ADDRESS OF TGT-A, line 2 nulls a USAGE PROGRAM-POINTER after SET PP TO ENTRY, line 4 nulls a pointer member of a STRONG typedef group, and lines 5 and 6 are the two controls -- the bare form still reaches the same receiver through GR5c4/GR6c, and a non-matching REPLACING still leaves it alone -- so the SET-to-NULL machinery is proved live in the same run before the VALUE arm is credited. CONFORMS, with both of the rule's remaining category words accounted for and NEITHER of them an unimplemented obligation. FUNCTION-POINTER: GR5c1a does not name it (verified on the licensed PDF, printed folio 639 -- the transcription is faithful and the asymmetry with GR4, GR6a1 and GR6c is the printed standard's own), and 13.18.63.3 SR9 forbids it a VALUE clause in either format, so GR5c1b and GR5c1c are false too; no conforming program can reach GR6a1 with a function-pointer receiver, and the arm is vacuous by the standard's construction rather than by an omission here. Under REPLACING, DEFAULT or the bare form it is still a receiving-operand and takes GR6c's 'Function-pointer | Predefined address NULL' row. MESSAGE-TAG: the message control system is an owner-declined optional facility (docs/CONFORMANCE.md A.3 item 4), no PicCategory carries that category, and no elementary item can therefore reach this rule with it.

[folded GR-14.9.20.4-L2.2 = §14.9.20.4 6) a) 2.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work/PB418.md — GR6a2, 'If the category of the receiving-operand is object-reference, the sending-operand is the predefined object reference NULL'. It failed through the SAME line as GR-14.9.20.4-L2.1 (InitializeSender's rawValue gate, which 13.18.63.3 SR9 guarantees is null for an OBJECT-REFERENCE entry) and is fixed by the same split: GR5c1a names object-reference, QualifiesCategorically() implements it, and ElementaryAction() emits GR4's implicit SET ... TO the predefined object reference NULL. MEASURED WITH A REAL INSTANCE, not reasoned from the pointer line -- an unset OBJECT REFERENCE is already NULL and would have passed for the wrong reason: conformance:cases/14.9.20-INITIALIZE/pb418_initialize_value_categorical declares REPOSITORY. CLASS PB418CL and 01 O1 USAGE OBJECT REFERENCE PB418CL, does INVOKE PB418CL "NEW" RETURNING O1, and line 3 shows INITIALIZE O1 ALL TO VALUE nulling it. Before the fix the same statement left O1 set while the bare INITIALIZE on the next line nulled it, which is what isolated the defect to the VALUE arm.

[folded GR-14.9.20.4-L2.3 = §14.9.20.4 6) a) 3.: CONFORMS]
kb/Work/PB420.md landed 2026-09-13. This row carries GR6a3 plus the transcription's merged 6b (the REPLACING sender) and 6c (the category-default table). Both of its recorded causes are now closed. The Format-2 carrier half - 6a3's second sentence, 'If the data item is a table element, the literal in the VALUE clause that corresponds to the occurrence being initialized determines the sending-operand' - landed with kb/Work PB418 (DataItem.ValueAt over the TableValuePlan, expanded per occurrence by ExpandTableValue) and is pinned by pb418_initialize_table_value_arms / _shapes. The OTHER cause was PB420's float deferral, which made the whole sentence UNMEASURABLE for a floating-point table element because the store threw before the sender mattered; with the deferral gone it is measured directly: `05 FE USAGE COMP-2 OCCURS 3 VALUES ARE 1.5 2.5 FROM (1) TO (2)` + `INITIALIZE FV ALL TO VALUE` leaves 1.5 / 2.5 / the prior content, the per-occurrence literal for the two occurrences the VALUE clause keys and NO store for the third (GR5c1c makes an unkeyed occurrence not a receiving-operand at all). 6a3's scalar half is pinned at the same edition by pb420_initialize_float_value_default_2002 V1/V2 - the float leaves read their VALUE literal back, and a float leaf with NO VALUE clause is untouched - and 6b/6c by initialize_phrases and by pb420_initialize_float_receiver_85 T1/T2/T3, whose T3 measures GR6c's 'Figurative constant ZEROES' into a NUMERIC receiver of float usage.
